title: Build terminal-first TUI intent and approval surface
purpose: Provide the operator-facing terminal surface for intent input, plan preview, status, approval, denial, and audit inspection.
entry_constraints: TUI is the native MVP surface; no web or native GUI is required for acceptance.
Approval UI must be a projection of policy/audit state, not the security boundary.
Plan preview must work with deterministic stub planner output.
Service recovery is the first concrete workflow family to optimize for.
scope: Render an interactive terminal shell or TUI attached to agentd.
Accept natural-language intent and show a deterministic plan preview from stub planner output.
Support approval, denial, timeout, and suspended states.
Show recent audit events and current run status.
acceptance_criteria: Operator can submit an intent and receive a frozen plan preview.
High-risk placeholder steps pause for approval and record the decision.
The TUI remains responsive while a simulated tool call streams status.
All visible actions map to structured agentd API calls.
The TUI can render Developer VM service recovery plan states without requiring GUI components.
verification: Run TUI integration test in local terminal.
Run boot image and confirm the first interactive surface is terminal-first.
Inspect audit events for approval and denial actions.
risk_notes: Do not make UI text the security boundary; policy decisions must live in agentd/policy.
